description: This file defines the interface and factory for the MediaPipelineIpc class, which facilitates IPC communication for media pipeline control in the Rialto client. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and references to external protobuf messages and other IPC components.

classes.name: MediaPipelineIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating instances of MediaPipelineIpc.

classes.name: MediaPipelineIpc
classes.description: Implements the IMediaPipelineIpc interface for IPC communication related to media pipeline control, and manages session lifecycle and event handling.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineIpc
methods.description: Creates and returns a new IMediaPipelineIpc instance for a given client and video requirements.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the pipeline and assigns a source ID.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from the pipeline by source ID.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all sources are attached.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media of a specified type, MIME type, and URL.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the video window position and size.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts media playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses media playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops media playback.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Indicates data availability and updates playback status.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the playback position.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback position.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Renders a video frame.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the playback volume.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the audio.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Checks if the audio is muted.

methods.name: onPlaybackStateUpdated
methods.description: Handles playback state change events from the server.

methods.name: onPositionUpdated
methods.description: Handles playback position change events.

methods.name: onNetworkStateUpdated
methods.description: Handles network state change events.

methods.name: onNeedMediaData
methods.description: Handles requests for media data.

methods.name: onQos
methods.description: Handles QoS update events.

methods.name: onBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Handles buffer underflow notifications.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new media session with specified video requirements.

methods.name: destroySession
methods.description: Destroys the current media session.

methods.name: convertLoadRequestMediaType
methods.description: Converts internal MediaType enum to protobuf LoadRequest_MediaType.

methods.name: convertHaveDataRequestMediaSourceStatus
methods.description: Converts internal MediaSourceStatus enum to protobuf HaveDataRequest_MediaSourceStatus.

methods.name: convertSegmentAlignment
methods.description: Converts SegmentAlignment enum to protobuf AttachSourceRequest_SegmentAlignment.

methods.name: convertStreamFormat
methods.description: Converts StreamFormat enum to protobuf AttachSourceRequest_StreamFormat.

methods.name: convertConfigType
methods.description: Converts SourceConfigType enum to protobuf AttachSourceRequest_ConfigType.

methods.name: convertCodecDataType
methods.description: Converts CodecDataType enum to protobuf AttachSourceRequest_CodecData_Type.
